note.p: Structural conversion of the Court Fee Table published by the High Court of Punjab and Haryana (issued over the signature of the Joint Registrar (Judicial-II)), together with the annexed Table of Rates of ad valorem fees leviable on the institution of suits as prescribed in the Court-fees Act, 1870. Each case-type row of the table is a separately addressable unit carrying its case type, nomenclature and fee, and each ad valorem slab is an item under its band. Text, figures and the source's own typography are reproduced verbatim, including the source's apparent slips at the Rs. 8,000-8,250 slab (printed 995.20 where the arithmetic of the surrounding slabs gives 955.20) and the doubled comma in the Rs. 2,800-2,900 row. The table carries no date of its own; the FRBR date is that of the stay order it records in Note 1.

section.heading: Notes to the Court Fee Table

item.p: Court Fees in the cases is being received by DRR Section/Registry as per the Court Fees Act, 1870 (Un-amended)/Notifications issued from time to time and the Court fee is being calculated as per the Court Fee Chart provided in the DRR Section. It is also submitted that Schedule I and II of Court Fees (Punjab Second Amendment) Act, 2009 has been stayed vide order dated 27.11.2013 passed by Hon'ble Mr. Justice Rakesh Kumar Garg (as His Lordship then was) in RSA No. 3311 of 2013. The Court Fees chart/schedule is subject to change at any time without any notification/publication by this Hon'ble Court in case any amendment/instructions are issued/received in this behalf by the appropriate Government and subject to the final decision of RSA No. 3311 of 2013.

Please also go through the relevant Statutes of the Gazette Notifications with regard to the payment of Court Fees in judicial matters/cases issued by the concerned State Governments from time to time.
